verdict.rationale: Khoj lets you create multiple agents, each with its own knowledge, persona, chat model and tools (khoj-gh-1) and custom system prompts (khoj-docs-12), and admins can add agents for separate use-cases such as Writer or Researcher (khoj-docs-26). Routing conversations or channels to specific agents is not documented in the evidence, so that half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented per-conversation agent selection, routing of channels (e.g. WhatsApp, Emacs, Obsidian) to specific agents, explicit per-agent workspace isolation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-agent use.
